prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **Apollo Health Insurance** looks like a strong first call for an individual or family plan: it’s a local, family-owned brokerage that says it compares multiple carriers and serves the Kansas City metro. Its site reports a 4.9/5 rating across 462 reviews. [Apollo](https://apollo-insurance.com/health-insurance-broker-kansas-city/)

For another option, **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** says it helps people compare ACA Marketplace and other coverage in both Kansas and Missouri, at no cost to clients. [AIS](https://aishealthadvisors.com/health-insurance/)

Before choosing, ask whether the broker is licensed in your state, which insurers they can compare, and whether they’ll check your doctors, prescriptions, and subsidy eligibility. Broker compensation is generally paid by insurers, but confirm there’s no fee and compare the recommendation with [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/).
